findings.evidence: The final pass proves source-level tests, typechecks, lint and production builds; no positive browser walkthrough or live Docker/Flyway upgrade was run because approved credentials/runtime data were not supplied.
findings.why_it_matters: Source verification does not prove a deployed local stack, real migration upgrade, or authenticated positive-path behavior.
findings.required_action: Run the documented local Docker migration and Playwright positive-path matrix with approved local seed accounts before release deployment.

findings.evidence: The new host workflow is selected in source and the legacy endpoint is fail-closed; a runtime feature flag/telemetry rollout switch is not yet present.
findings.why_it_matters: A staged rollout would reduce operational risk while old clients are still being migrated.
findings.required_action: Add a server/client rollout flag and deprecation telemetry before enabling the workflow for production tenants at scale.
